notes.title: V0.2.1 patch
notes.content: Due to how ragdoll implementation was done, it prevented the kill counter from rising. This resulted in the game being impossible to win, but this patch rectifies that matter. You may now continue your slaughter.

notes.title: V0.2 dropping with the New Year!
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone! As promised, here's an update for the New Year. Next will be control and animation improvement.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Ragdolls now work for both peasants and guards
[/list]

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Added:
[list]
[*] Werewolf now wears a Santa hat for the month of December. This will extend to future monsters as well.
[/list]

More was intended to come out with this update, but a number of problems were met during development. The next update circles around ragdolls for the peasants, as well as re-structuring the internal design of the werewolf and peasants. This will allow the development process to be streamlined with development for the other monster types, as the building blocks will already be there and will just leave for minor adjustments. You can expect this update by the end of the year!

That's all regarding this update; Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!

notes.title: V0.1.1 Bug fixing and changes
notes.content:
V0.1.1 changes:
        * Addition of healing each night
	* Peasants knocked over from a lunge with a peasant in hand no longer stay on the ground
	* Hit marker sound added
	* Fix game over screen not showing cursor
	* Main menu backdrop updated with game logo and version number
	* Fixed camera snapping to head randomly
	* Fixed character animations breaking when pausing while moving
	* Guard attack damage reduced.
